memory.assumption: CPU shared host pointers and compact indexed BVH; unchanged conservative Blender mesh and image envelopes, explicit full host+kernel attributes, 48B/T compact BVH allowance, and fixed 2GiB application/build-scratch/render/denoise headroom. Import and trace peaks are disjoint after an explicit source-cache release. This backend-specific sum replaces the older blanket Metal estimate and 25% multiplier; it does not raise either resource threshold. Actual RSS/available monitoring remains authoritative.
unmeasuredRisks: Embree allocator/leaf occupancy and build scratch are implementation-based estimates, not a measured full-scene bound.
The existing official job must terminate its own process if actual RSS exceeds 14GiB or available/reclaimable memory drops below 3GiB.

actualAvailable.method: Actual macOS free+inactive+speculative pages; not total RAM or a claim all caches will be reclaimed instantly
